task: Classify relation between a scoped claim and supplied API documentation, not runtime correctness.

labels.supports: Declaration explicitly supports claim under stated conditions.
labels.contradicts: Declaration explicitly rules out claim under stated conditions.
labels.undetermined: Missing information, ambiguous conditions, unrelated declaration or incompatible statements.

native_training_row.questions: Same frozen declaration_relation schema as the diagnostic pilot; not rewritten per example.

experiment_order: Frozen base model and simple rule baseline on development data
Small supervised labeled-data fine-tune using native Laya trainer, initially freeze_encoder=true
Compare unfreezing encoder only if development results justify the cost
Fit temperatures and abstention policy on repository-separated calibration data
Freeze checkpoint, prompt, tokenizer, dtype, budgets and policy
Run final test once and report uncertainty and challenge slices
native_trainer_note: TrainConfig normally splits calibration items internally at random. Set calib_frac=0.0 for the already grouped train set, pass eval_data from development only, then perform separate fitting on the reserved calibration set. Validate this path before training. No trained checkpoint or fitted policy exists yet.
promotion: Do not set a confidence threshold from these four diagnostics. Compare improvement against frozen base/rule, including false-support and coverage uncertainty. Model confidence never upgrades source authority.
